item.tib: tshe dbang rig 'dzin snying thig las mkha' 'gro thugs rje kun grol ma'i sbyin sreg dregs pa dbang bsdud
item.coloph: zhes 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying thig las mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dregs pa dbang bsdud zhes bya ba 'di ni yul gangs can zhing gi char gtogs dngul rdza zal mo sgang gi ru lag gnas mchog g.yung drung lha rtse nas bskal pa 'brug zla'i tshes bzang por o rgyan pad ma gling pas rnyed cing slar rim can bka' rgya grol nas bka' babs las can sems dpa' sogs kyis ngos gtan la phab pa ste thog ma'i yi ge pa ni bstan 'dzin tshul khrims bdag gis las dang bskal (skal) pa bzang po'i bka' chab thos 'dzin skyid (dpyid) du lhug par brtsol bzhin bris pa'i/ dge des bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam chab (chabs) gcig skye dang skye ba kun tu rgyal dbang dam pa'i mdun du 'khod cing ngoms med gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu ru shog cig tshe dbang rig 'dzin snying thig las mkha' 'gro thugs rje kun grol ma'i sbyin sreg dregs pa dbang sdud rdzogs so
